title: Thesium chinense Turcz. and its compound astragalin alleviate lipopolysaccharide-induced acute lung injury via the PI3K/AKT/p53 signaling pathway.
authors: Xu, Haonan; Zhang, Fang; Che, Yan; Sun, Tingting; Che, Ke; Cui, Yu; Zhou, Niannian; Wan, Jun; Chang, Wenlong; Guan, Yueqin; Huang, Yuying; Chen, Hao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药百蕊草及其成分黄芪苷通过PI3K/AKT/p53通路缓解急性肺损伤，虽含分子动力学模拟但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Thesium chinense Turcz. (TCT) is a traditional Chinese medicinal plant commonly used in clinical practice for respiratory diseases, known for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. However, the mechanisms by which TCT alleviates acute lung injury (ALI) remain not fully understood. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aims to validate the efficacy and elucidate the mechanisms of TCT in the treating ALI through experimental and network pharmacology approaches. MATERIALS AND METHODS: To find the bioactive substances in TCT, ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography in conjunction with quadrupole-exactive mass spectrometry (UHPLC-QE-MS) was employed. The therapeutic effects of TCT were assessed by oxidative stress assessments, histological analysis (HE staining), inflammatory cytokine evaluations (RT-qPCR, immunofluorescence, immunohistochemistry), and TUNEL apoptotic staining in mice with lipopolysaccharide-induced ALI models. TP53 was identified as a crucial therapeutic target and astragalin as a pivotal drug by network pharmacology analysis. Their binding properties were verified by molecular dynamics simulations using GROMACS. The effects of astragalin on cell apoptosis (flow cytometry), cytokine expression (RT-qPCR), and protein expression (Western blot) were examined in vitro using LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages. RESULTS: In TCT, 24 key bioactive chemicals were found using UHPLC-QE-MS. TCT significantly reduced LPS-induced ALI, decreased levels of inflammatory cytokines TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta, decreased NFkappaB expression, increased superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity, decreased malondialdehyde (MDA) content, and reduced lung tissue cell apoptosis, according to the pharmacological results. The PI3K/AKT/p53 signaling pathway is essential for treating ALI, and astragalin was identified as the main drug and TP53 as the critical target by network pharmacology analysis. Strong binding and stability between astragalin and TP53 were demonstrated by molecular docking and dynamics simulations. Astragalin dramatically decreased early and late apoptosis, blocked p-PI3K and p-AKT activation, activated p53, and repressed the production of TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta in vitro. CONCLUSION: This study suggests that TCT and its active compound astragalin alleviate LPS-induced ALI by modulating the PI3K/AKT/p53 signaling pathway, offering a potential therapeutic approach for treating ALI.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：百蕊草（Thesium chinense Turcz., TCT）是一种传统中药植物，常用于临床治疗呼吸系统疾病，以其抗炎和抗氧化特性而闻名。然而，TCT缓解急性肺损伤（ALI）的机制尚未完全阐明。研究目的：本研究旨在通过实验和网络药理学方法，验证TCT治疗ALI的疗效并阐明其作用机制。材料与方法：为发现TCT中的生物活性物质，采用超高效液相色谱结合四极杆-静电场轨道阱质谱（UHPLC-QE-MS）技术。通过氧化应激评估、组织学分析（HE染色）、炎症细胞因子评估（RT-qPCR、免疫荧光、免疫组织化学）以及TUNEL凋亡染色，在脂多糖诱导的ALI小鼠模型中评估TCT的治疗效果。通过网络药理学分析，TP53被确定为核心治疗靶点，紫云英苷（astragalin）为关键药物。利用GROMACS进行分子动力学模拟验证其结合特性。在体外实验中，使用LPS刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞，检测紫云英苷对细胞凋亡（流式细胞术）、细胞因子表达（RT-qPCR）和蛋白表达（Western blot）的影响。结果：通过UHPLC-QE-MS在TCT中鉴定出24种关键生物活性化合物。药理学结果显示，TCT显著减轻LPS诱导的ALI，降低炎症细胞因子TNF-α、IL-6和IL-1β水平，减少NFκB表达，增加超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性，降低丙二醛（MDA）含量，并减少肺组织细胞凋亡。PI3K/AKT/p53信号通路对治疗ALI至关重要，网络药理学分析确定紫云英苷为主要药物，TP53为关键靶点。分子对接和动力学模拟证明了紫云英苷与TP53之间的强结合力和稳定性。在体外实验中，紫云英苷显著减少早期和晚期凋亡，阻断p-PI3K和p-AKT激活，激活p53，并抑制TNF-α、IL-6和IL-1β的产生。结论：本研究提示，TCT及其活性化合物紫云英苷通过调节PI3K/AKT/p53信号通路缓解LPS诱导的ALI，为治疗ALI提供了一种潜在的治疗策略。
